name: flow_match_found_accept_then_play_again_requeues
description: A player who came alone through the queue (design 5.5, 5.9): Find players, three strangers fill the seats, Match Found opens on the server's 15 s (MATCH FOUND, the mode and seats, 3 of 4 accepted, the seconds), Accept answers ACCEPT and reads Accepted; the match forms as a match of strangers (the strangers' Builders unclashed: the main where free, else the backup, else a free one), loads and plays; on the results Play again goes back to the party and queues again at once, 'Entering queue...' until the server says queued.

steps.assert: Session.get_node_or_null('MatchFound').lines() == ['MATCH FOUND', 'High Water · 4 players · ~13 min', '3 of 4', '15 s', 'Accept']
steps.msg: the plate: the mode, four players, three accepted, the server's 15 s

steps.assert: Session.get_node('MatchFound').find_child('MatchFoundWhere', true, false).text == 'The tide turns at Wickhollow'
not Session.get_node('MatchFound').find_child('MatchFoundAccept', true, false).disabled and not Session.get_node('MatchFound').find_child('MatchFoundDecline', true, false).disabled

steps.msg: the seconds and the bar count the server's window down
the match forms; I came alone through the queue
the match found is the match: my party's seat first, the strangers in the order they came

steps.assert: seats[0]['builder'] == 0 and seats[1]['builder'] == 1 and seats[2]['builder'] == 2 and seats[3]['builder'] == 3
steps.msg: Builders unclashed: Edda keeps the Lookout; Ottilie's main and backup are taken, so the first free, the Bellfounder; Wen's too, the Beekeeper
Play again said LEAVE_MATCH, then QUEUE enter: queued again
